messages.subject_clean: Box plot in example file "Weather" not displaying correctly
messages.body_plain:
Hello All,

Is anyone else having issues with the Rattle box plot display using
the wetaher dataset?

When i first executed the file as per Peters instructions graphs 1, 2
and 3 were displaying incorrectly, then i unselected use Cairo
Graphics and all but graph 1 was correct.

graph 1 refers to the Box plot of the Rainfall variable using
Distributions type.

The appearance suggest the data is exceeding some boundary? see the R-
code below.

#============================================================
# Rattle timestamp: 2010-12-01 16:23:30 i386-pc-mingw32

# Box Plot

# Subset the data for a boxplot of the variable Rainfall  with the
appropriate groups.

ds <- rbind(data.frame(dat=crs$dataset[crs$sample,][,"Rainfall"],
grp="All"),
            data.frame(dat=crs$dataset[crs$sample,][crs$dataset[crs
$sample,]$RainTomorrow=="No","Rainfall"], grp="No"),
            data.frame(dat=crs$dataset[crs$sample,][crs$dataset[crs
$sample,]$RainTomorrow=="Yes","Rainfall"], grp="Yes"))

# Plot the data, grouped appropriately.

bp <- boxplot(formula=dat ~ grp, data=ds, col=rainbow_hcl(3),
xlab="RainTomorrow", ylab="Rainfall", notch=TRUE)

# The 'doBy' package provides the 'summaryBy' function.

require(doBy, quietly=TRUE)

# Calculate the group means.

points(1:3, summaryBy(dat ~ grp, data=ds, FUN=mean, na.rm=TRUE)
$dat.mean, pch=8)

# Add a title to the plot.

title(main="Distribution of Rainfall (sample)
by RainTomorrow", sub=paste("Rattle", format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%b-%d %H:
%M:%S"), Sys.info()["user"]))

Good Evening:

I have read through many of the Windows users who have had Rattle installation problems. I have tried all of the fixes that I found and that seemed to apply to my problems. For some reason every time I attempt to launch Rattle with rattle() I am prompted with the Need GTK+?... dialogue box. I have been through so many uninstalls and reinstalls that I have honestly lost count. Once I get through another reinstall I get the same error when trying to launch rattle():

I think the key here is that you may have two versions of GTK interfering with each  other. Essentially, never install gtk 2.12.9 (nor any other version other than 2.22.0) and make sure every incarnation of it is removed from the computer and do some file searching to make sure you can't find any gtk files hanging around. Then install 2.22.0 and the rest.

At least that would be my guess.

Hope that works.

Regards,
Graham

messages.body_plain:
Hi Graham

I have noticed that the generated scripts reference hard-coded column
numbers when building models and graphs.  What would you think of
having the generated code be driven off crs$input?  This would allow
the script to be changed in one place only...

# example code generated random_forest.R line 200:
crs$rf <- randomForest(RainTomorrow ~ .,
     data=crs$dataset[crs$sample,c(3:22, 24)],
     ntree=500,
     mtry=4,
     importance=TRUE,
     na.action=na.roughfix,
     replace=FALSE)

# a possible alternative
crs$rf <- randomForest(RainTomorrow ~ .,
     data=crs$dataset[crs$sample,c(crs$input,crs$target)],
     ntree=500,
     mtry=4,
     importance=TRUE,
     na.action=na.roughfix,
     replace=FALSE)

If you think this is a good idea I'm happy to pull together a patch.

Shane
